correctness.rationale: Each fan spanning tree is equivalent to a composition of path vertices into positive blocks separated by deleted path edges, with exactly one hub spoke per block; length-one, length-two and longer blocks have the displayed leaf weights, and one-block trees make the hub an additional leaf. Hence the bivariate exact Z_n generating function follows. The dominant simple pole r solving t*r/(1-r)^2=1 is isolated for every fixed t>0 by nonnegative aperiodic block coefficients; analytic perturbation yields a quasi-powers moment generating function, mean nµ(r)+O_t(1), variance nv(r)+O_t(1) and Gaussian fluctuations with v>0. Independently differentiated the implicit pole equation and confirmed exact µ and v rational functions. Differentiation gave dv/dr=-2p(r)/(1+r)^4; an exact rational Sturm root count confirms p has precisely one root in (0,1), implying unique global variance-density maximizer t*=(1-r*)²/r* since v→0 at both endpoints. These are fixed-t asymptotics, not finite-n optimizer claims.
